governance_standard: NOVA Sourced & Dated Fashion Intelligence Standards

trends.description: Architectural high-rise trousers and jeans that curve outward dramatically at the hips and outer thigh before tapering sharply back in at the ankle.
trends.source_title: The Rise of Horseshoe and Barrel-Leg Jeans in Contemporary Street Style

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Fitted baby tee, tucked-in fine-gauge knit, or nipped-in blazer to balance lower volume
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Rigid high-waisted barrel-leg denim or tailored wool-blend horseshoe pants
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Pointed-toe slingback kitten heels, almond-toe loafers, or slim retro sneakers (avoid chunky dad shoes)
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Minimalist leather belt with silver hardware, structured shoulder bag

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: All climates; choose 100% cotton for dry heat, tropical-weight wool for evening
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Elevated casual, creative workplace, gallery openings, weekend social

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: High-street curved-seam denim from accessible retailers or thrifting vintage tapered jeans sized up and darted.

trends.trend_name: Butter Yellow as the Soft Alternative Neutral
trends.description: Pale, creamy, warm pastel yellow that functions as an understated neutral base, replacing stark optical white and cold greys.
trends.source_title: Why Butter Yellow Is the Defining Color Trend of Recent Runways

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Butter yellow silk-cashmere knit polo or fluid satin blouse
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Warm ivory wide-leg pleated linen trousers or washed denim
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Chocolate brown leather loafers or cream kitten-heel mules
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: 18k gold vermeil jewellery, rich tan leather tote

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Ideal for warm and tropical weather; reflects heat while maintaining color depth
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Daytime networking, brunch, garden weddings, creative professional

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Linen button-down dyed in soft butter tone paired with staple cream trousers.

trends.description: Semi-transparent fishnet, mesh, and delicate lace ballet flats that introduce negative space and airy tactile contrast to outfits.
trends.source_title: The Mesh Shoe Phenomenon: How Alaïa's Flats Changed Warm-Weather Dressing

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Crisp poplin oversized button-down or sheer layered tank
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Puddle trousers with relaxed hem or midi slip skirt
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Black or beige sheer mesh ballet flats with single buckle strap
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Cord pendant necklace, woven straw or raffia shoulder bag

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Excellent for hot, dry or mild summer weather; avoid in wet monsoon conditions
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Casual city days, weekend cafes, summer dinner

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Woven crochet or micro-mesh Mary Janes from high-street collections.

trends.description: Slim, low-profile retro track and martial arts-inspired trainers (Adidas SL72, Puma Speedcat, Miu Miu hybrid ballet sneakers) replacing chunky platform 'dad shoes'.
trends.source_title: The Death of the Chunky Sneaker: Rise of Sleek Low-Profile Runners

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Oversized tailored blazer over vintage jersey or plain baby tee
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Fluid wide-leg trousers pooling over the flat toe-box, or sporty track shorts
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Sleek suede low-profile retro runner in chocolate/cream or bold primary color
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Sporty canvas tote or half-moon leather cross-body

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: All seasons; breathable suede/mesh upper suited for moderate climates
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Everyday college, travel, casual Friday, creative office

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Classic canvas low-top plimsolls or vintage racing trainers from secondary marketplaces.

trends.description: Seams and bodices extending past the natural waist to the low hip before flaring into a fluid A-line, bubble, or pleated skirt, creating an elongated sculptural torso.
trends.source_title: Why the Drop-Waist Silhouette Has Captured Modern Runways and Red Carpets

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Fitted drop-waist bodice or longline knit extending to upper hip
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Flared pleated lower hem or integrated cotton poplin skirt
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Pointed kitten-heel mules or minimalist flat leather sandals
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Delicate pearls, ribbon hair ties, miniature clutch

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Light cotton poplin or silk suited for warm weather
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Summer galas, cocktail parties, evening dates, art exhibitions

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Drop-waist poplin sundresses from accessible contemporary brands.

trends.description: Subverting athletic streetwear by pairing vintage football/rugby jerseys with sharp formal tailoring, pleated mini/midi skirts, or leather dress shoes.
trends.source_title: Blokecore: How Football Kits Became High Fashion's Favorite Streetwear Trope

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Vintage oversized long-sleeve striped rugby or football jersey
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Knife-pleated midi skirt or relaxed straight-leg dark wash denim
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Black leather loafers with white crew socks, or low-profile retro trainers
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Rectangular rimless sunglasses, nylon cross-body bag

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Breathable moisture-wicking synthetic jersey fabric ideal for warm humid climates
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: College campus, weekend hangout, music concerts, casual creative agency

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Thrifted vintage sports jerseys paired with existing pleated schoolgirl skirts or tailored trousers.

trends.description: Hyper-feminine romanticism featuring delicate ribbons, lace trim, and sheer pastel fabrics juxtaposed with moody dark leather jackets or heavy footwear to avoid saccharine cliché.
trends.source_title: The Evolution of the Coquette Aesthetic: From Hyper-Sweet to Edgy Contrast

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Delicate lace-trim camisole or sheer babydoll top in blush or ivory
suggested_garment_combinations.outerwear: Worn vintage distressed brown leather motorcycle jacket
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Silky slip skirt or micro pleated skirt with lace hem
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Chunky Mary Janes with ribbon ties or matte leather knee-high boots
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Bow hair barrettes, cord ribbon choker

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Mild to warm; layer jacket for evening chill
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Cafes, indie music gigs, weekend dates, museum visits

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Lace-trimmed thrifted camisoles styled with an oversized second-hand leather jacket.

trends.trend_name: Indian Gen Z Desi-Western Kurti-Denim Fusion
trends.description: Subverting formal Indian ethnic codes by styling short Lucknowi Chikankari or hand-block printed cotton kurtis as daily tops paired with baggy low-rise jeans, cargo pants, or denim skirts.
trends.source_title: How Gen Z in India is Rewriting the Everyday Wardrobe with Desi Fusion

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Short pastel Chikankari cotton kurti (thigh-length, relaxed cut) with sleeves rolled
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Baggy wide-leg medium wash blue denim or olive utilitarian cargo pants
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Classic tan leather Kolhapuri flats or clean low-profile white sneakers
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Oxidised silver jhumka earrings, canvas tote bag, tiny black bindi

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Engineered for 30°C-38°C Indian heat and humidity; breathable mulmul/cotton ensures all-day comfort
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: College lectures, casual cafe outings, library sessions, creative studio work

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Locally sourced street-market Lucknowi cotton kurtis paired with affordable high-street baggy jeans.

trends.trend_name: Oxidised Silver Jewellery with Contemporary Streetwear
trends.description: Juxtaposing heritage Indian oxidised silver jewellery (layered tribal chokers, heavy silver jhumkas, multi-finger rings) with western streetwear staples like boxy blazers, graphic tees, and hoodies.
trends.source_title: Silver Linings: Why Gen Z is Obsessed with Oxidised Silver Jewellery

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Oversized washed charcoal graphic tee or unstructured black linen blazer
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Straight-leg ecru denim or dark grey tailored trousers
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Chunky leather loafers or clean skate shoes
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Tiered oxidised silver coin choker, stacked silver rings, minimal silver ear cuffs

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: All climates; sweat-resistant natural metals suited for humid environments
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: College fests, art pop-ups, indie concerts, informal social gatherings

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Authentic street-market artisan brass/silver alloy jewellery from local bazaars (Janpath, Colaba Causeway).

trends.description: Deep wine, oxblood, and dark black-cherry shades dominating leather jackets, structured bags, and footwear as the premium alternative to black.
trends.source_title: The Saturated Wine Spectrum: Deep Cherry and Oxblood Dominate Fall/Winter

suggested_garment_combinations.outerwear: Glossy or distressed dark cherry leather jacket or tailored wool overcoat
suggested_garment_combinations.top: Oatmeal or charcoal cashmere crewneck knit
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Charcoal tailored straight-leg trousers or dark indigo denim
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Deep burgundy polished leather loafers or sleek ankle boots

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Suited for mild to cold weather (winter evenings in North India; cool global seasons)
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Evening dining, gallery openings, cocktail receptions, executive casual

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Thrifted faux-leather oversized jacket in deep wine paired with staple dark jeans.

trends.description: Fitted, calf-grazing trousers ending below the knee, revived from noughties pop-culture and styled with sharp modern tailoring.
trends.source_title: The High-Fashion Rehabilitation of the Capri Pant

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Oversized structured linen blazer worn buttoned as a top, or crisp poplin shirt
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Tailored stretch-cotton black or khaki capri pants ending mid-calf
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Kitten-heel slingbacks or low-profile ballet flats to elongate the ankle
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Slim 90s sunglasses, structured mini handheld bag

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Warm weather; exposes lower leg while maintaining tailored upper modesty
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Creative workplace, summer brunch, fashion events

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Tailoring thrifted slim trousers to a precise mid-calf hem.

trends.description: Traditional Indian natural-dye block-print textiles tailored into modern gender-neutral summer sets (boxy Cuban-collar shirts with relaxed drawstring shorts or trousers).
trends.source_title: Artisanal Streetwear: Indian Block Prints Get a Modern Co-ord Makeover

suggested_garment_combinations.top: Boxy Cuban-collar half-sleeve shirt in hand-block indigo/madder Ajrakh print
suggested_garment_combinations.bottom: Matching or contrast ecru relaxed-fit drawstring cotton shorts or linen trousers
suggested_garment_combinations.footwear: Tan leather braided slides or handcrafted mojaris
suggested_garment_combinations.accessories: Handcrafted brass cuff, round wire-frame sunglasses

climate_and_occasion_suitability.climate: Breathable 100% cambric cotton engineered for extreme heat (35°C-42°C)
climate_and_occasion_suitability.occasion: Summer vacations, weekend markets, casual travel, creative casual

trends.budget_friendly_alternatives: Direct-from-weaver cotton block-print shirts paired with plain neutral shorts.
